title: Flutter Run & Debug (FlutterRun) Debug Adapter Configuration

label.description: Human-readable name for this debug configuration.

request.description: Launch a new app or attach to a running one.

type.description: Debug a Flutter app or a plain Dart program.

cwd.description: Working directory. Defaults to the worktree root.

toolArgs.description: Extra arguments for flutter run / flutter attach (for example --flavor dev, -d <id>).

env.description: Environment variables for the debug adapter and the app.

flutterMode.description: Build mode for launch. profile and release are added as --profile / --release in toolArgs.

deviceId.description: Device id; the proxy adds -d <id> unless toolArgs already selects a device.

platform.description: Accepted for copy-paste compatibility with Dart-Code; ignored.

vmServiceUri.description: VM service URI to attach to (request attach). Also set toolArgs with -d <device>.

vmServiceInfoFile.description: File containing JSON {"uri": "ws://..."} (request attach). The bare-string file written by flutter run --vmservice-out-file does not work (the adapter waits forever); use vmServiceUri instead.

stopOnEntry.description: Pause at the first line of the program.

debugSdkLibraries.description: Passed through to the Dart/Flutter debug adapter.

debugExternalPackageLibraries.description: Passed through to the Dart/Flutter debug adapter.

evaluateGettersInDebugViews.description: Passed through to the Dart/Flutter debug adapter.

evaluateToStringInDebugViews.description: Passed through to the Dart/Flutter debug adapter.

sendLogsToClient.description: Passed through to the Dart/Flutter debug adapter.

useFvm.description: Require the SDK selected by FVM for the project.

flutterSdkPath.description: Flutter SDK root. First step of SDK resolution.

reloadOnSave.description: Hot reload when files are saved: only changed files, every save, or off.

reloadOnSaveGlobs.description: Extra globs, relative to the project, that also trigger a reload. Each must start with a directory, for example assets/**.json.

reloadOnSaveDebounceMs.description: Wait after the last change (10 to 5000).

openDevTools.description: Page to open in the browser when the app starts (never = do not open). Needs DDS, so not available with --no-dds.

logFile.description: Write the proxy's debug log and DAP traffic to this file.
